source: VENAT Atlas: A digital venous neuroanatomy atlas of the human brain (Bazin et al., Figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7205960)
notes: VENAT (Venous Neuroanatomy Atlas) mapped from 7 Tesla Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping (QSM).
Values represent venous probability density from 0 to 255 (1.0).
Thresholding at density >= 140 (approx 0.55) defines the major dural venous sinuses.

labels.description: Probability density map of dural sinuses (Superior Sagittal, Straight, Transverse, Sigmoid) and deep internal cerebral veins derived from high-resolution 7T QSM.
